Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Stonebridge renewal ~5w. Sudden drop in embeddings + search calls, procurement asking for a side-by-side vs "Vectorly". Putting triage here.
Ethan (AM): can you paste quick usage/latency slice?
Maya (CSM): telemetry: 14d tokens/day 24k -> 6.8k -> 2.1k; active seats 30 -> 18; p95 embed ~95ms (stable); no recent errors.
Rita (Sales): Vectorly pitched lower $/1M embeds. Do they want on-prem or just price proof?
Priya (Stonebridge): Procurement looped new infra lead Jonah. Main asks: cost per 1M w/ & w/o caching, on-prem feasibility, BYOK. Finance paused new annual commits until pilot.
Sam (Eng): We can offer a 7-day dedicated pilot (2xA10) + Optimize audit. BYOK for Private needs extra setup (~2w). We can produce a perf matrix and a short reproducible script.
Ethan (AM): propose pilot (discounted), perf matrix, 30m tech readout. Rita/Ethan — can you own commercial terms?
Rita (Sales): I'll draft pilot commercial (20% pilot discount) and loop Legal.
Maya (CSM): I'll schedule tech readout, collect Jonah's p95 / cost targets, and share a one-pager for Finance showing expected cost delta with caching.
Priya (Stonebridge): If you can show ~3x reduction in unit cost after caching we'll fast-track internally.
ops-bot: renewal_watch:stonebridge:1751110001 assigned:@Maya; reminder set 72h.
